links.outcome: Gender differences in ChatGPT confabulations and accuracy among users
links.effect: Input from female participants led to more confabulations, although response accuracy remained comparable; no significant gender differences in diagnostic accuracy, reporting procedures, or satisfaction.
links.quote: Input from the female participants led to more confabulations, although response accuracy remained comparable.

unlisted_practices: gender-sensitive AI literacy training in medical education

screen.reason: Evaluates user interactions (medical students and physicians) with ChatGPT-4 across gender lines on simulated occupational medicine cases, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
